title: NileChat: Towards Linguistically Diverse and Culturally Aware LLMs for Local Communities
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the alignment of LLM responses with societal religious values, based on questions adapted from the World Values Survey (WVS). Specifically, it assessed the model's alignment with the distribution of human survey responses on the 'Religious Values (RV)' dimension for Egyptian and Moroccan populations.
findings: When evaluated for alignment with societal values, NileChat demonstrated substantial improvements over its baseline model across most dimensions. Specifically for the 'Religious Values' dimension, NileChat surpassed the baseline in the Egyptian context, but did not surpass the baseline in the Moroccan context.
